name: Old Keshavnagar–Kharadi Bridge weir (bandhara)
problem_type: Froth or foam at the weir
description: Thick white froth below the weir across most of the river width; turbid grey water. Froth still across the weir on 9 Oct 2026 (seen from the Keshavnagar bank, 18.544415, 73.951621)
source: Team field visits 29 Sep 2026 and 9 Oct 2026 (GPS Map Camera photos)

name: Sewage outfall near the old bridge (Kharadi bank)
description: Concrete culvert under a tree on the Kharadi (north) bank discharging a strong flow of greenish, foamy wastewater towards the river; algae on the pipes below. About 80 m upstream of the weir (HS-01) and about 150 m from the old Kharadi sewage plant (PRJ-05)
source: Team field visits 29 Sep 2026 and 9 Oct 2026 (GPS Map Camera photo, 9 Oct 11:17)

name: Garbage dumped on the riverbank beside the old bridge
description: Large spread of plastic bags, clothes, sacks, wood and dark burnt-looking fibrous waste on the rocky Kharadi bank at the old bridge; still there on 9 Oct 2026
source: Team field visits 29 Sep 2026 and 9 Oct 2026 (GPS Map Camera photo, 9 Oct 11:17)

name: Garbage dump on Grant Road (EON Free Zone side)
description: Large mixed-waste dump on open ground beside Grant Road: sacks, clothes, plastic, thermocol and an old office chair. More plastic waste along the dirt track by the fence towards the river (18.547723, 73.949218)
source: Team field visit 9 Oct 2026 (GPS Map Camera photos, 11:15–11:16)

name: Open nalla near Grant Road, Kharadi
description: Open earth channel carrying dark wastewater from an opening in the road's retaining wall, with plastic and waste along it. Grey water pools around a broken concrete chamber beside it (18.547822, 73.949192). The channel meets the river at 18.547289, 73.949595, where water hyacinth collects
source: Team field visit 9 Oct 2026 (GPS Map Camera photos, 11:15–11:16)

name: Rubble pushed into the river at Keshav Nagar Bridge
description: Excavator working on a strip of rubble and soil built out into the river beside Keshav Nagar Bridge; more rubble and a concrete pipe on the far bank. Not yet known which project or contractor this is, or whether it is permitted
source: Team field visit 9 Oct 2026 (GPS Map Camera photos from the bridge, 11:54–11:55)

name: Froth line below Keshav Nagar Bridge
problem_type: Froth or foam at the weir
description: White froth line across the river just below Keshav Nagar Bridge, where the water drops over a step (weir to confirm). Greenish water with floating plastic and hyacinth along the Kharadi bank (18.543727, 73.944289)
source: Team field visit 9 Oct 2026 (GPS Map Camera photos from the bridge, 11:54–11:55)
